content.description:
8-Bit Mania is the community of Pixel lovers. Each of these Unique & Limited designs is being minted on the Cardano Blockchain.

8-Bit Mania’s goal is to be one of the first NFT Community running on the Cardano Blockchain. You'll own an unique asset, You’ll be able to collect and/or trade these. We will create a gallery on Pavia too so you could promote our community to everyone and we'll rent a plot on MetaVerse to organize events in community.
